external_dataset_registry_2026.policy: download when license and split policy permit; otherwise create internal distillation seeds and keep official eval rows quarantined

notes: Synthetic-only fallback rows never satisfy real family minima.
Eval-only and benchmark-holdout rows stay out of train even when permissively licensed.
Agentic/tool traces require schema validation, secret redaction, and successful-eval trajectory quarantine.
Codex and agent-memory traces use dedicated ingest modules; Claude and Hermes traces use the generic 2026 trace normalizer until dedicated modules exist.
The orchestrator attempts omnicoder.data_factory.curation_layers_2026 when present and otherwise applies the built-in 2025-2026 JSONL fallback curation layer.
No ORM, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, or backup database path is used by this profile.

postgres.notes: JSONL curation is the default. Enable only after raw PostgreSQL schemas and environment credentials are configured.

reinforcement_exports_2026.promotion: reward replay and heldout all-modality sample-loss eval before benchmark smoke/release gates
